torch_seed_per_episode: 1_000_003 * sampling_seed + env_seed, set after the chain
valid_episode: after the chain the door is open and the hand is empty
state_repeat: H-7a.5: full grid encoding + agent pose + carried object recur within pickup_box's own episode; argmax episodes only

implementation_choices.loading: run-store directories hold no registry meta.json, so NodeRegistry.load_into cannot read them; the script builds the node from the spec, requires run.json's node_spec to equal it, loads policy_state_dict.pt, and requires the loaded weights' policy_sha256 to equal the one the run recorded
implementation_choices.load_check: each model's argmax score on the held-out seeds 20000-20049 under its own hook must equal the held-out score its training run recorded, or the script stops
implementation_choices.own_hook_harness: SubgoalEnv, the harness training's held-out score uses
implementation_choices.handoff_harness: plain env (execution_env_factory) from UnlockPickup's own reset, chain(unlock_door, drop_held) as H-7a.5's condition H
implementation_choices.crosscheck: in every row the argmax episodes must equal evaluate_node and the sampled ones run_episode under the same torch seed, episode for episode, or the script stops
implementation_choices.validation_gate_strictness: episode for episode (success and steps), not only the per-sampling-seed counts the plan asks for
implementation_choices.validity_check: read once after the chain, from the StateView: a door exists and is open, carrying_type is None; validity is the same in the argmax and sampled pass (the chain is argmax and consumes no torch RNG), checked
implementation_choices.timeouts: failures that used pickup_box's full timeout (120 steps); failures cut short by the env's own step limit are counted separately as env_ended
implementation_choices.state_repeats: counted over argmax failures among valid episodes
implementation_choices.verdict: computed by the script from the plan's fixed rule; seed 42 is excluded
implementation_choices.smoke: --smoke runs the gate on 10 seeds and 10 seeds per row and writes nothing
implementation_choices.extension_output: --extension scores seeds 48-52 exactly as 43-47 were scored and writes runs/v2/w1a_pickup_box_sampled_ext.json; the 43-47 file is read, never rewritten, and the ten-seed verdict (>= 7 of 10) is computed from both
implementation_choices.env_ended_label: on the own-hook row (SubgoalEnv) the wrapper truncates at pickup_box's own timeout, so env_ended there equals timeouts and does not mean the env's 288-step limit; on the handoff row it does

handoff.harness: plain env from reset; unlock_door -> drop_held (FROZEN, argmax), then pickup_box
